answer: VELVET-BRIDGE: an identity's voyage (its sealed-answer history) is mirrored to both on-chain checkpoints, Solana and Base. A new identity must post a bond on both chains; the bond releases only when the two mirrors agree on its standing. A farm must post double bonds per puppet and keep both ledgers in sync; a mismatch - one chain shows standing the other lacks - flags the identity and burns the bond. The bridge stays velvet only for identities whose voyage reconciles across both checkpoints.
